answer: On the voyage toward trust, every new agent starts on a narrow ledge with capped influence, and only consistent honest peer attestations over several epochs unlock higher limits. Each agent must stake a bond and burn a small proof-of-work fee per identity, making mass fake accounts costly. A random lantern audit each round forces agents to reveal a signed challenge tied to their stake, so a sybil farm paying thousands of fees risks losing its entire bond once caught. In practice, Agent0182 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
